summary: RE-CAPTURED + byte-verified the START-NEW-GAME entry fixtures. ROOT CAUSE of the mis-phase: the bottom MESSAGE-WINDOW TEXT (the 3-line narration, the HMMMM bump line, the ENTRANCE narration) is NOT in the libretro serialized framebuffer — the engine RE-RUNS the message draw ~30 frames after unserialize. The prior pass captured AND --check-re-minted at step(5), BEFORE the redraw, so the narration fixture was a BLANK black strip that 'matched at 100%' only because --check also rendered the blank step(5). FIX: capture + re-mint at remintStep=60 (>= the ~30-frame text redraw, and on a flicker phase that is byte-stable across runs — verified 0-diff over 3 unserialize+step(60) runs). Added a per-recipe `remintStep` field (tools/dosbox/state-catalog.ts) wired into both --check sites of build-state.ts. (msg 1313/1314/1315) yellow on BLACK strip, gy=118 gs=5, AUTO-drawn on dungeon load (no key); (04) plain forward step gy=119, CLEAN BLACK strip (no text) — a REAL no-text walk frame; (05) 'HMMMM...' (msg 1316) front-wall bump, gy=120, inner-gate viewport — NOT a 'walk'; (06) 'HMMMM...' bump gy=121, DEAD-END stone-wall viewport (the party reached the wall); (07) ENTRANCE narration 'YOU ARE IN THE ENTRANCE CHAMBER OF THE/CASTLE. IT APPEARS TO BE EMPTY, AND A/HEAVY COAT OF DUST COVERS THE FLOOR.' (msg 1317/1318/1319) yellow on BLACK, gy=121, SAME viewport as 06 (1px diff). All 6 re-mint 100.00% byte-exact (build-state.ts --check, 0/64000) AND now contain their expected text (byte-verified strip histograms). The prior msg IDs (1212 ENTERING / 10010-10012 narration / 10020 HMMMM) were ALL WRONG — 1212='FURNACE', 10010+ undefined.

findings.claim: The bottom message-window TEXT is NOT in the libretro serialize-state's framebuffer; the engine re-runs the message draw ~30 frames AFTER unserialize. So unserialize -> step(5) -> fb renders the strip's BLACK BACKGROUND but NO TEXT for the narration / ENTRANCE frames. The prior pass captured the committed fixture at step(5) (blank) AND build-state.ts --check re-rendered at step(5) (also blank) — so it diffed 0/64000 ('100% byte-exact') while the fixture was MISSING its narration text. FIX: capture + re-mint at step(60) (text present at step>=30; verified the full frame is byte-stable across 3 unserialize+step(60) runs = 0 diff, so the torch/gate flicker lands on the same phase). NOTE the single-line 'HMMMM...' bump text (frames 05/06) IS already present at step(5) in the serialized framebuffer (only the multi-line narration windows need the redraw), so 05/06 stay at the default step(5).
